title: I planned this as a 1 month project. 4 months later, my idle auto-battler is almost ready for Steam early access
author: Ok_Fudge3144
selftext:
Hey everyone,



For the last 4 months I've been making an idle / auto-battle RPG called TASK: GOLIATH, completely alone. It goes into early access on Steam in about 2-3 weeks.



Some background: I've played mobile idle games for years. Taskbar Hero, Idle Heroes, AFK Arena, AFK Journey and a lot more. At some point I just wanted to make one myself. Honestly I planned it as a one month project and now I'm in month four. What ate most of my time was character animations. If I knew how long that part would take, I probably wouldn't have started at all.



What it is: you build a squad from 10 operators (tank / dps / support actually matter), combat is automatic and it keeps going while the game is closed. 1000 stages, gear forging, research trees, a starbase you build up, and small hands-on puzzles so it's not only watching numbers go up. There's also async PvP and clans.



About monetization, since I know it'll be the first question: it's free to play. There's a season pass that gives a little extra resources and a monthly VIP card. The biggest thing VIP gives is unlimited use of Selen, an in-game assistant you give commands to by typing or voice ("send the team to PvP", "open inventory" etc). It's not a chatbot, it's a command system, and voice recognition runs locally on your PC with whisper.cpp, nothing goes to a server. I don't think there's anything in there you could call pay to win, but if you see it differently I'm listening.



Also being upfront about AI: voices were made with ElevenLabs and some portraits/textures were AI assisted, then edited by me. The music was made with Suno. It's disclosed on the Steam page too.



One more thing. If anyone likes what they see and wants to help, as a hobby or professionally, I'd be really happy. Design, 2D art or animation, Godot/GDScript, music, sound, translation, testing, anything really. Right now it's just me.



Any feedback is welcome, harsh too. I only ask you to keep in mind there's 4 months of one person's work behind it.



Steam page: [https://store.steampowered.com/app/5115470/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5115470/)



(English isn't my strong side, so I wrote this in Turkish and translated it with AI.)
